$comment: Every ending a loop is allowed to have, and what each stage may spend before it stops. Without the second and third, a task that cannot be done consumes attempts until somebody notices, and what somebody notices first is the bill.

attempts.why: Two attempts with the reason attached recovers most ordinary failures. A third rarely finds anything the second did not, and the item is more useful in front of a person.

claim.why: A push to a remote. Longer than this is a network problem, not a work problem.

context.why: Reading declared files. Longer means the router is walking the repository.

implement.why: The only stage where thinking is the work.

gates.why: Three suites in three languages, cold.

verify.why: A focused read of the diff. Left unbounded it replays the whole implementation.

human.why: Not bounded. A person takes the time a person takes, and the number is recorded so it stops being invisible.
